samples.question: Start at the green START circle and move away from it. At the first purple junction take the leftmost forward branch; at the next junction take the rightmost forward branch; keep alternating leftmost, rightmost. Never go back along the link just used. Links meet only at circles and never cross. Which colored terminal is reached? Answer red, blue, orange, or cyan.
